title: Pattern to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences
body_markdown:
LEHI, Utah—November 10, 2026—Pattern Group Inc. (Nasdaq: PTRN) (“Pattern”), a leader in accelerating brands on global ecommerce marketplaces, announced today that senior management will participate at the following investor conferences:


‍


**BMO Technology & Innovation Leaders Conference**


Thursday, November 12, 2026


New York, NY


Format: Fireside chat, 1x1 and small group meetings


‍


**Needham Virtual Consumer Tech/E-Commerce 1x1 Conference**


Monday, November 23, 2026


Virtual


Format: 1x1 and small group meetings


‍


**UBS Annual Global Technology & AI Conference**


Monday, November 30, 2026


Scottsdale, AZ


Format: 1x1 and small group meetings


‍


**Morgan Stanley Global Consumer & Retail Conference**


Tuesday, December 1, 2026


New York, NY


Format: Fireside chat, 1x1 and small group meetings


‍


**Wolfe Research Badishkanian Small Group December Conference**


Monday, December 7, 2026


Virtual


Format: 1x1 and small group meetings


‍


**Raymond James TMT and Consumer Conference**


Tuesday, December 8, 2026


New York, New York


Format: Fireside chat, 1x1 and small group meetings


‍


Live and archived webcasts of the fireside chats will be available on Pattern’s investor relations website at[https://investors.pattern.com/](https://investors.pattern.com/) .


‍


**About Pattern**


‍Pattern accelerates brands on global ecommerce marketplaces leveraging proprietary technology and AI. Utilizing more than 100 trillion data points, sophisticated machine learning and AI models, Pattern optimizes and automates key levers of ecommerce growth for global brands, including advertising, content management, logistics and fulfillment, pricing, forecasting and customer service. Hundreds of global brands depend on Pattern’s ecommerce acceleration platform every day to drive profitable revenue growth across more than 80 global marketplaces—including Amazon, TikTok Shop, Walmart.com, Target.com, eBay, Tmall, JD, and Mercado Libre.


‍
